column3: The Hebrew ends with an independent I will not stumble clause; BSB makes it without wavering attached to trusting.
The Hebrew names kidneys and heart and pictures refining them; BSB has heart and mind and examine.
The Hebrew names men of vanity and concealed ones; BSB says deceitful men and hypocrites.
The Hebrew describes hating as completed and says I will not sit; BSB says I hate and refuse to sit.
The Hebrew joins washing and going around with and; BSB makes going around a purpose clause.
The Hebrew names the habitation of Your house; BSB says the house where You dwell.
The Hebrew has right hand in the singular; BSB has right hands.
The Hebrew has foot in the singular; BSB has feet.
